name: vtt
description: Private, locally hosted D&D 5e combat VTT

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@vtt/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@vtt/server"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace=@vtt/server
scripts.docs: npm run map && npm run docs:generate --workspace=@vtt/api-contract && npm run docs:parity --workspace=@vtt/web
